_comment: Every source the data build uses, one entry each. The About page and the site footer list these, and
etl/tests/test_sources.py checks them against DATA_NOTICE.md, the fetch allowlist and data/manual/*.csv:
name: appears in the entry's DATA_NOTICE.md section, and in label. label: shown on the site.
terms and gives: the About page's summary; footer_note: shown after the footer link. notice: its DATA_NOTICE.md heading.
hosts: the fetch allowlist hosts it's fetched from. cited_as: how data/manual/*.csv rows citing it begin;
citation_hosts: the hosts of those rows' source_url. Adding a source means a new entry here, plus
DATA_NOTICE.md, docs/DATA_SOURCES.md and the fetch allowlist (see CLAUDE.md).

sources.name: Purdue STAT 695 dataset
sources.label: Purdue STAT 695 dataset
sources.gives: weekend charts 1982-2016, Box Office Mojo's as compiled in March 2017 for an R package.
sources.notice: Box office figures, 1982–2016: Purdue STAT 695 dataset

sources.name: Wayback Machine
sources.label: Internet Archive Wayback Machine
sources.gives: archived copies of Box Office Mojo's weekend charts and release pages, 2017 on, and of the pages our hand-curated figures cite.
sources.notice: Box office figures, 2017–present: archived Box Office Mojo pages

sources.name: Common Crawl
sources.label: Common Crawl
sources.gives: the same Box Office Mojo pages, for any weekend the Wayback Machine lacks.

sources.name: Wikidata
sources.label: Wikidata
